title: asq Office API error
description: The body of every non-2xx /api response (data-contract.md §3 ApiError, §5, and backend-v1.4.md §7 for the 1.4 additions). error is one of the finite codes below; detail says more — for invalid, which field was bad. This is the LOCAL error shape and stays distinct from service.json#/$defs/ServiceError, which describes why a remote read produced no data inside a 200 ServiceResult. backend-v1.4.md §7 documents the translation between them; nothing may mix the two.

error.description: v1: unauthorized 401 · no_such_agent/no_such_project/no_such_task 404 · not_fleet/no_pane/not_waiting/fleet_unavailable/team_disabled 409 · invalid 400 · timeout 504 · internal 500. v1.1: wrong_kind/not_working 409 · too_large 413. v1.3: not_ended/no_gui_answer/mode_change 409. 1.4: contract_revision_required/stale_prompt/idempotency_conflict/unsupported_capability/target_not_assignable/binding_required/service_unconfigured 409 · operation_not_found 404 · service_unavailable 503 · outcome_unknown 409, used only when a caller demands a definitive result the back-end does not have; the ordinary way to report an unconfirmed mutation is 202 with an Operation whose status is outcome_unknown.
